1. (Currently Amended) An apparatus, comprising: an encoder (300) for encoding mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to encode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence, __and wherein the mode mapping information comprises a reordering of available modes based on frequency of mode usage in previously coded pictures of the sequence__.

7. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the adapted mode mapping information is updated after encoding one or more pictures of the sequence __based on statistical analysis of mode usage patterns__.

8. (Previously presented) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the actual parameters are determined from at least one of coding information for one or more previously coded pictures in the sequence, a selected subset of a set of adapted mode mapping information relating to at least a portion of the sequence, one or more partial encoding passes for the picture, statistics of one or more pictures in the sequence, statistics of one or more portions of the one or more pictures in the sequence, and statistics of the sequence.

9. 15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 9, wherein the adapted mode mapping information is updated after encoding one or more pictures of the sequence (550, 960) __based on statistical analysis of mode usage patterns__.

16.
